prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept animation source frame.
Asset type: 64x64 transparent decorative overlay frame for a Hearts of Iron IV scripted-GUI status seal.
Primary request: Create a compact, original aged-bronze ornamental ring overlay with a narrow sculpted rim and one small dark-ink and bronze ribbon flourish attached to its outer edge. The ring overlays a separate status medallion. Its centre must remain a large, completely transparent aperture so the underlying status symbol is fully visible; there is no disk or artwork behind the ring.
Style/medium: painterly HOI4 game-icon metalwork, aged bronze bevel highlights, dark recessed edge, a restrained ink curl, fine material detail that survives at 64x64.
Composition/framing: fixed centred ring, outer diameter about 60 pixels on the final 64x64 canvas, at least 2 pixels of transparent margin on every side; inner transparent aperture at least 48 pixels across. Keep the ring axis fixed at (32,32).
Lighting/mood: warm bronze edge highlights, low-key dark recesses, no glow.
Color palette: aged bronze, muted warm gold and near-black ink only; neutral metal shading is allowed, no bright accent color.
Constraints: request genuine transparent background in this initial frame call and preserve real transparency through the entire centre aperture and all unused canvas. The rim must be a narrow annulus, not a medallion face. Exactly one small flourish, confined to roughly one eighth of the circumference; no other symbols or decoration.
Avoid: opaque centre, navy disc, star, status mark, tick marks, text, lettering, flag, ribbon banner, extra subjects, background, fake checkerboard, matte, halo, clipped ring, blur, or white outline.
Motion state: frame 000 seed at 12 o'clock. The one flourish sits at the top of the rim, curling clockwise to the upper right. The flourish is a short curved strip with a curled end and a small ink-dark underside.
reference_roles: bronze rim material and small-icon scale only; do not copy the navy face, star, or ticks

motion_state.note: ImageGen placed the seed flourish on the upper-right arc; the frame plan was updated to use this accepted position and subsequent frames advance clockwise.
